description.text: The smallest number which will be divisible by 96, 136 and 504 is –

properties.html: The smallest number which will be divisible by 96, 136 and 504 is –

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

The LCM of 96, 136 and 504 is –
Prime Factorization of 96 is: 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 = 25 x 31
Prime Factorization of 136 is: 2 x 2 x 2 x 17 = 23 x 171
Prime Factorization of 504 is: 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 7 = 23 x 32 x 71
So, the LCM = 25 x 32 x 71 x 171 = 34272

description.text: What is the ratio of L.C.M of 7, 12 and 21 & H.C.F of 21, 105, and 189?

properties.html: What is the ratio of L.C.M of 7, 12 and 21 & H.C.F of 21, 105, and 189?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Prime Factorization of 7 is: 7 is prime = 71
Prime Factorization of 12 is: 2 x 2 x 3 = 22 x 31
Prime Factorization of 21 is: 3 x 7 = 31 x 71
So, the LCM is = 22 x 31 x 71 = 84
The factors of 21 are: 1, 3, 7, 21

description.text: Which of the following number gives remainder 4 in each case when divided by 7, 9 and 11?

properties.html: Which of the following number gives remainder 4 in each case when divided by 7, 9 and 11?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Prime Factorization of 7 is: 7 is prime = 71
Prime Factorization of 9 is: 3 x 3 = 32
Prime Factorization of 11 is: 11 is prime = 111
so, the LCM is = 32 x 71 x 111 = 693
So, required number will be in the form of = 693k + 4; where k is any integer
If we put k = 5, then correct answer is = 3469 i.e. option (B).

description.text: The least number which will give remainder 4 in each case when divided by 12, 16, 18, 20 and 25 is?

properties.html: The least number which will give remainder 4 in each case when divided by 12, 16, 18, 20 and 25 is?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Prime Factorization of 12 is: 2 x 2 x 3 => 22 x 31
Prime Factorization of 16 is: 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 => 24
Prime Factorization of 18 is: 2 x 3 x 3 => 21 x 32
Prime Factorization of 20 is: 2 x 2 x 5 => 22 x 51
Prime Factorization of 25 is: 5 x 5 => 52
so, the LCM is = 24 x 32 x 52 = 3600
therefore, required number is = 3600+4 = 3604

description.text: Which of the following number gives remainder10, 20, 30, and 35 when divided by 15, 25, 35, and 40 respectively?

properties.html: Which of the following number gives remainder10, 20, 30, and 35 when divided by 15, 25, 35, and 40 respectively?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Here common difference is equal is each case, 15-10 = 25-20 = 35-30 = 40-35 = 5
Now, Prime Factorization of 15 is: 3 x 5 => 31 x 51
Prime Factorization of 25 is: 5 x 5 => 52
Prime Factorization of 35 is: 5 x 7 => 51 x 71
Prime Factorization of 40 is: 2 x 2 x 2 x 5 => 23 x 51  
So, the LCM is = 23 x 31 x 52 x 71 = 4200
Therefore, required number is = 4200 – 5 (common difference) = 4195
